description: The four Do-lane policies of ontology task 061 (D-16, D-31, D-43, D-54): subject-only Existence rules evaluated by the ONE evaluator (SignalEvaluator via the nightly SignalReevaluationJob), reproducing the Daily Briefing collector's predicates (the due-soon window is the POML's three days; the collector's own is the caller's Due-soon setting). Applied to Dataverse by scripts/Apply-DoLanePolicies.ps1 (idempotent upsert by the fixed ids below). Policies are created with sprk_enabled = No; the owner turns them on after review, and the script never changes sprk_enabled on an existing row. A version row is immutable once published (FR-49): a changed body, plan or template is a NEW version (a new entry with a higher versionNumber and its own id), never an edit of this one. The overdue threshold is the 'now-1d' in each overdue body (D-43: starts at 1 day; tune in UAT by publishing a new version). Event rules read sprk_duedate, never sprk_finalduedate (D-27).
